title: ADR-011: Option A enrichment model — Python assembles, Rust ingests once
description:
Record ADR-011 in ADR.md before any M2 code is written.

Decision: Python Understanding layer runs all enrichers on the RawDocument in-memory, merges EnrichmentResults into a fully-enriched RawDocument (blocks populated), then writes to job file. Rust ingests once. No partial KOs in the Library.

Also record: re-enrichment path (add blocks to existing KO without content_hash change) is deferred to M3, when OCR async enrichment makes it a necessary design. M2 recovery story for GROBID failure: fail the job cleanly; user re-runs alcanzai ingest when GROBID is available.

Acceptance: ADR-011 entry committed to ADR.md covering the above + options considered (Option B two-phase rejected: requires new Library API, architecturally contradicts DESIGN.md §3.2, partial-KO observable state).
